name: Detect ad spend anomalies and budget pacing across Google Ads, Meta and GA4

parameters.content:
## Detect ad anomalies and budget pacing with approvals

This template watches Google Ads, Meta Ads and GA4 together. It flags spend spikes and ROAS drops against each campaign's own baseline, checks month-end budget pacing, and spots possible tracking breaks. No change is made without a human clicking Approve.

### How it works
1. A daily trigger loads 35 days of campaign data from Google Ads, Meta and GA4.
2. A Code node compares yesterday with the trailing average (z-score) for every campaign.
3. It also projects month-end spend against your budgets and compares GA4 sessions with ad clicks.
4. You receive one digest email, plus one approval email per proposed pause.
5. Only approved pauses run, and **Dry Run** is on by default.

### Setup
1. Click **Test with Sample Data**. No credentials are needed.
2. Fill in **Workflow Configuration**: IDs, developer token, budgets, target ROAS, approver email.
3. Connect Google Ads OAuth2, Meta Graph API, Google Analytics OAuth2 and Gmail credentials.
4. Set sampleMode and dryRun to false and emailsEnabled to true when ready.

### Customization tips
Change thresholds in the config node, add Slack instead of Gmail, or extend the actions beyond pausing.

## 1. Triggers and settings
Schedule or sample run, plus all IDs, budgets and thresholds.

## Before going live
Get the developer token from the Google Ads API Center and keep it private. Set dryRun to false only after reviewing a few digests.

## 2. Load campaign data
Live Google Ads, Meta and GA4 data is fetched, merged and normalized, or built-in sample data with planted anomalies is used.

## 3. Detect issues
Anomalies, budget pacing and tracking gaps.

## 4. Human approval
Digest email and one approval email per proposed pause.

## 5. Run approved action
Dry run log, or pause in Google Ads or Meta.

={{ JSON.stringify({ query: "SELECT segments.date, campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.clicks, metrics.impressions, metrics.conversions, metrics.conversions_value FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '" + $('Workflow Configuration').first().json.startDate + "' AND '" + $('Workflow Configuration').first().json.endDate + "'" }) }}
